verdict.rationale: Official docs confirm a Gemini mobile app: on Android you can say "Hey Google" to get help with what's on screen, and the same mobile-app help page covers features like Maps and Flights planning. That page also notes some mobile app features aren't available on work or school accounts, which matters for a knowledge-worker. missing for 10: any evidence of an official iOS app, documentation showing the mobile apps are full-featured (parity with web/desktop), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
